name: Siren Song
text: Whenever one or more creatures attack you, remove up to one target creature with mana value {N} or less attacking you from combat. You gain control of it until the end of your next turn.

name: Phase I — The Chorus
text: When this phase begins, for each opponent, you gain control of the creature with the greatest power among creatures they control (each one, on a tie).

name: Phase II — The Drowning Song
text: Creatures your opponents control attack each combat if able. Whenever a creature with mana value {N} or less attacks you, remove it from combat. You gain control of it until the end of your next turn.

name: Borrowed Words
text: Once during each of your turns, you may cast an instant or sorcery card with mana value {N} or less from an opponent's graveyard without paying its mana cost. If a card cast this way would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead.

name: Phase I — The Stacks Collapse
text: When this phase begins, each opponent mills ten cards. Once during each of your turns, you may cast a creature card with mana value {N} or less from an opponent's graveyard without paying its mana cost.

name: Phase II — The Final Lesson
text: Once during each of your turns, you may cast another instant or sorcery card with mana value {N} or less from an opponent's graveyard without paying its mana cost; if it would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead. Whenever you cast a spell from an opponent's graveyard, copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy.

name: Grasping Deep
text: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you control fewer than {N} Tentacles, create 1/1 blue Tentacle creature tokens until you control {N}. They have "Whenever a creature attacks you, you may sacrifice this token. If you do, tap that creature and remove it from combat. It doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step."

name: Phase I — The Tower Floods
text: When this phase begins, return each creature that isn't a Kraken, Leviathan, Octopus, Serpent or Tentacle to its owner's hand. Lands are Islands in addition to their other types.

name: Phase II — The Deep Takes All
text: Creatures you control get +2/+2 and have islandwalk.
